title: Reasons registry: introduce family aggregates
description:
lib/merge-task-reasons.mjs has grown to 26 exports (12 reason constants + 12 builders + 2 misc) — past the 25-builder soft threshold flagged in TASK-013/014/016 reviews. Architect-reviewer flagged ARCH-W-016-2 (low severity).

Introduce frozen family aggregates without breaking flat exports (additive, no migration needed):
- REASON_CLOSE_FAMILY = Object.freeze({ ok: REASON_CLOSE_OK, alreadyDone: REASON_CLOSE_ALREADY_DONE, ... })
- REASON_COMMIT_FAMILY = Object.freeze({ ok: REASON_COMMIT_OK, noChanges: REASON_COMMIT_NO_CHANGES, ... })
- REASON_LINKED_FAMILY = Object.freeze({ ... })

Family aggregates enable downstream pattern-match dispatch (e.g., switch on family.ok vs family.failed) without forcing consumers to memorize 12 individual constant names. Flat exports remain for back-compat.
acceptance_criteria: lib/merge-task-reasons.mjs exports REASON_CLOSE_FAMILY, REASON_COMMIT_FAMILY, REASON_LINKED_FAMILY as Object.freeze'd objects
All existing flat exports remain unchanged (no breaking change to consumers)
tests/unit/merge-task-reasons.test.mjs is extended with cases proving the families are frozen and contain the expected member constants
